scope: All 25 OTA development/support studies; excludes dense raw waveforms, caches, environments and duplicated tool archives. Original native PDK model cards are not distributed.

entries.title: Original seven-transistor two-stage OTA
entries.status: Historical voltage-bias baseline; characterization, schematic and original results.

entries.title: Behavioral SC / OTA / SAR model
entries.status: Supporting system model; not a transistor-level PDK simulation.

entries.title: Current-reference bias and channel-length sweep
entries.status: Ideal current reference plus diode-connected mirror; length/current/compensation tradeoffs.

entries.title: Independent stage and device-group tuning
entries.status: Selected high-gain compromise plus faster and lower-power alternatives.

entries.title: Extracted metal-capacitor compensation
entries.status: Parasitic and plate-orientation study; capacitor library itself remains in the existing capacitor directory.

entries.title: Further capacitor / OTA analysis
entries.status: Historical compensation exploration; inspect the included report and measurements.

entries.title: Capacitor layout / OTA parasitic comparison
entries.status: Historical layout-capacitance tradeoffs; does not qualify precision SC capacitors.

entries.title: MOS capacitor and capacitance-multiplier feasibility
entries.status: Feasibility experiment, not a qualified active precision capacitor.

entries.title: MOS-only compensation selection
entries.status: Six PMOS gate-capacitor units selected in the original schematic-level experiment.

entries.title: First MOS-compensated OTA physical layout
entries.status: Local DRC/LVS pass; historical initial layout.

entries.title: Compact symmetric layout and extraction
entries.status: Compact ABBA arrangement, local DRC/LVS and exploratory extraction.

entries.title: Poly / metal parasitic attribution
entries.status: Analysis of extracted capacitance by layer; not a new OTA topology.

entries.title: Extracted MOS-compensation retuning
entries.status: Capacitor-count and reference-current tradeoffs on the compact extracted model.

entries.title: Current versus MOS-capacitor optimization
entries.status: Nine units / 3.5 uA balanced candidate under provisional screening limits.

entries.title: Physical nine-unit MOS-capacitor revision
entries.status: Actual schematic and GDS update; corrected physical finger geometry.

entries.title: SC integrator test with layout-v3 OTA
entries.status: Assumed CS=2.5 pF, CF=7.5 pF, VREF=1.5 V; these are not the newly uploaded SCA values.

entries.title: Series-resistor / MOS compensation study
entries.status: Six units plus 16 kohm ideal resistor screening; later physically implemented separately.

entries.title: Native SCL08 RPP resistor validation
entries.status: Native resistor, physical cell, symbol, topology image and validation.

entries.title: Integrated OTA / RPP extraction and PVT
entries.status: Six-unit / 16 kohm layout passes local DRC/LVS but fails the assumed full stability envelope.

entries.title: Two-stage stability recovery
entries.status: 12 MOS-cap units, 28 kohm RPP, widened output PMOS; minimum main-grid PM 62.22 degrees; slower settling.

entries.title: Alternative OTA architecture comparison
entries.status: Basic fully differential, telescopic, folded, gain-boosted telescopic and class-AB prototypes versus the two-stage baseline.

entries.title: Telescopic / gain-boosted OTA SC comparison
entries.status: Both candidates tested in the previously assumed SC circuit; gain boosting provides little sampled benefit in that benchmark.

entries.title: First telescopic layout: extracted CMFB failure
entries.status: Historical failed candidate: local DRC/LVS pass, but resistor parasitics destabilize CMFB. Do not use as the current design.

entries.title: Telescopic OTA with corrected CMFB
entries.status: Current verified telescopic prototype: local DRC/LVS pass, 1442 successful AC checks, minimum CMFB PM 63.75 degrees. C-extraction only, not full signoff.

entries.title: MOS active-resistor feasibility
entries.status: Direct NMOS / complementary substitutions simulated; corner failures prevent replacing the verified poly network. No active-resistor layout.
